survey: A round-bellied witch's cauldron, seen from slightly above and in front, standing on a tiled floor. A thick rolled rim runs around the mouth. It is filled almost to the rim with bubbling green liquid, and three dome bubbles sit on the surface inside the rim. Two ring handles, one on each side just below the rim, hang from square lugs that are fixed to the body. The two handles match each other in size and height. Two short, thick legs with flared feet are visible, front-left and back-right. Both join the underside of the belly and stand flat on the floor tiles, with contact shadows. A third leg could be hidden behind, which is normal for a three-legged cauldron. A small fire of crossed sticks with an orange glow sits on the floor under the base, between the legs, close enough to heat the bottom. The bowl is a believable round shape, the rim is an even ellipse, and the liquid stays inside the rim.
